newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Golf-Lonard shoots to early second round PGA lead.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Golf-Lonard shoots to early second round PGA lead.

text.p: Peter Lonard took a one stroke lead in the Australian PGA championship at the New South Wales Golf Club on Friday after birdies at four of the first five holes of his second round.
Lonard was one of 54 players who had to complete their first rounds early on Friday after wind disrupted play on Thursday.
The New South Welshman completed his first round in three-under-par 69 to be three shots behind overnight leaders Wayne Riley and Bryan Roach.
Jerry Kelly of the United States fired a second round 66 after starting at one-over to be two shots behind Lonard.
Wayne Smith drew level with Riley and Roach after finishing his first round but fell back to two-under after completing the first nine holes of his second round in four-over 40.
Riley and Roach both had afternoon tee-off times.
